item.title: ‘They will die cruel deaths’ – Community Cat feeding program in Catch-22 situation
item.description: CharleAnne Sher has been feeding 20 TNR cats at Estuary Apartments for 12 years, but apartment managers have told her to stop, leaving the cats in a difficult situation and Sher feeling "stabbed in the heart". The post ‘They will die cruel deaths’ – Community Cat feeding program in Catch-22 situation appeared first on Rough Draft Atlanta.

item.description: Sen. item.title: Children’s Healthcare of Atlanta’s CEO Donna Hyland to retire
item.description: Children's Healthcare of Atlanta announced the retirement of its longtime CEO Donna Hyland, who will be succeeded by Dr. Patrick Frias, a former CHOA cardiologist, chief physician officer, and chief operating officer. The post Children’s Healthcare of Atlanta’s CEO Donna Hyland to retire appeared first on Rough Draft Atlanta.

item.title: Video targeting ‘sharia law’ draws a new candidate to lieutenant governor race
item.description: State Sen. Greg Dolezal's campaign video depicting Muslims terrorizing white Georgia residents has drawn criticism from both sides of the aisle, while state Sen. Nabilah Parkes has entered the race for lieutenant governor to push back against xenophobic rhetoric.
